current_documented_source.reason: The committed evidence source map labels this file as a candidate governed proxy source and explicitly keeps purchase recommendation authorization false.

activation_requirements: Devon explicitly approves the market provider and retrieval method.
The adapter is committed and listed in the active-code registry.
The adapter preserves provider, product identifier, price, shipping, quantity, observed timestamp, retrieved timestamp, region, currency, language, condition, and source status.
A failed source is reported as failure and never converted to zero listings or no market change.
Raw observations are stored immutably before normalization.
The normalized price and listing authorities are generated from the same snapshot ID.
The snapshot passes source, freshness, coverage, identity, hash, and lineage certification.
Every downstream stage is listed in the active-code registry and consumes the certified snapshot explicitly.
End-to-end lineage certification passes before recommendation publication.
prohibited_behaviors: Use a candidate proxy source as an executable current-price authority.
Use a downstream generated timestamp as a market observation timestamp.
Select a source because it is the newest matching file.
Forward-fill or carry forward current prices without an explicit ineligible status.
Run unregistered model or recommendation scripts as authoritative production steps.
Publish rankings, maximum purchase prices, or recommendations before authority activation.
